sourceNote: Stems were written to match the phrasing style AWS uses in its own published sample questions (scenario-first, one best answer). No sample-question text or scenario was copied.

templates.label: Service identification
stems: Which AWS service {purpose}?
A team needs the AWS service that {purpose}. Which service should they use?
Identify the AWS service that {purpose}.

templates.label: Use case matching
stems: A company wants to {useCase}. Which AWS service is the best fit?
Which AWS service is designed to {useCase}?
An architect is asked to {useCase}. Which service should they choose?

templates.label: Service category
stems: Into which AWS service category does {name} fall?
{name} belongs to which category of AWS services?

templates.label: True or false
stems: True or false: {statement}
Is the following statement about AWS correct? "{statement}"

templates.label: Which statement is NOT true
stems: Which of the following statements about {name} is NOT true?
All of the following are true of {name} EXCEPT which one?
templates.explanationLead: The incorrect statement is the answer. About {name}:

templates.label: Scenario
stems: A company needs to {need}. Which AWS service best meets this requirement?
A solutions architect must {need}. Which service should they select?
Which AWS service should a team use when they need to {need}?

templates.label: Shared responsibility model
stems: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for {item}?
In the AWS shared responsibility model, {item} is whose responsibility?
templates.explanationLead: AWS is responsible for security OF the cloud; the customer is responsible for security IN the cloud.

templates.label: Pricing and billing
stems: How are you charged for {name}?
Which statement best describes the pricing model for {name}?

templates.label: Core concept
stems: Which AWS concept {purpose}?
Which of the following {purpose}?

templates.label: Odd one out
stems: Which of the following is NOT a {categoryLabel} service?
Three of these are {categoryLabel} services. Which one is not?
templates.explanationLead: The odd one out is the answer.

responsibilityOptions.label: Shared between AWS and the customer
